meta.title: Add a surrogate bid on a closed RFQ, company allows surrogate bids after expiry
gaps: Verify that the company setting allowing surrogate bids after expiry is enabled.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Verify that the company setting allowing surrogate bids after expiry is enabled.

plan.title: Late surrogate bid on closed RFQ

steps.note: Open the existing closed RFQ directly on its Participants tab as required for prepared-state cases.

args.goal: On the closed RFQ's Participants tab, click Add Bid for an invited vendor, enter 95 for every line, enter "Phone quote 27 Oct" in the Surrogate Bid Reference field, save the bid, and stop on a screen showing that the late surrogate bid was accepted and marked as a Surrogate Bid.

steps.note: The standard surrogate-bid step is unavailable for the prepared closed state, so perform the buyer-side late-bid flow on screen.
Assert that the saved bid is visibly marked as a surrogate bid.
